transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess things have just been a little difficult lately. And... what finally scared me into actually making an appointment is... I've just been having these thoughts. Like... maybe if I just didn't wake up tomorrow, that might be easier. I mean, I don't want to hurt myself or anything. I just... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?

I suppose so, yes. Um... most mornings lately, I just... I wake up with this heavy feeling. It's just sort of... gray. Like all the color has already drained out of everything before I even get dressed for the store.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... I'd say... maybe about six months? Just... this low, flat feeling. It's been going on long enough that... well, I used to take morning walks, and I had an art class I liked, but... they just stopped helping. So I stopped going.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yes. I suppose so. Like I mentioned with the art class... sometimes I'll still set out my paints at home, or I'll think about going to pottery. But... when I actually sit down, I just stare at the materials. That spark I used to feel... it's just not there anymore.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight lately?
No, not really. My clothes still fit the same.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt on edge.
Have you been having any problems with your sleep lately?
No... I sleep fine, I suppose. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

I suppose... maybe a little bit. Just work things. I keep replaying little mistakes at the store... like a display sign being crooked, or if a trainee looks confused. I just... I start telling myself I'm a useless supervisor.
Have you been feeling like you're moving more slowly than usual or having trouble getting things done?

I suppose... it depends on the day. Some days I catch myself just... pacing around the living room, picking at my cuticles. But then other days... just walking from the break room out to the sales floor feels strangely slow. I don't really know why.
Are there still things that give you pleasure?

I don't know... I suppose. I still set out my paints sometimes. Or I think about going to that pottery class I used to like. But... when I actually try to do it, I just sit there staring at the clay or the brushes. I don't know, I just... that spark I used to get from it, it's just not there right now.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't?
No... no, nothing like that. I just... I don't hear things or see things. It's just my own thoughts, really.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt this low?
I don't think so. I mean... I'm not really sure. I've always just focused on my work and kept busy. I don't really dwell on the past much... so, no, not that I can recall.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt somewhat better, or has it been consistently this low?
Not really... no. It's just been... pretty much the same every day. I haven't really noticed a difference.
Have you had any thoughts of self-harm, beyond just not wanting to wake up?

No... I don't want to hurt myself. I wouldn't do that. It's just... I guess that's what finally scared me into making this appointment. Just having those thoughts that... well, if I didn't wake up tomorrow, it might just be easier. But no... nothing beyond that.
Have you been unable to experience pleasure most of the time?

I suppose... yes. I mean, I still try. I'll set out my paints, or... think about going to my pottery class. But... when I actually sit down with it, I just kind of stare at the materials. I don't... there's just none of the spark I used to feel.
Have you had any significant changes in your appetite lately?
No... not really. I don't think so, anyway. It's... pretty much the same as usual, I guess.
Have you had any feelings of worthlessness?

I... well, I suppose. It's hard not to feel that way sometimes. I just... I keep replaying these little things at work. Like... if a display sign isn't perfectly straight, or if one of the new trainees looks a bit confused. I just... I start thinking I'm completely useless at my job. That I shouldn't be a supervisor at all.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt somewhat better?
I don't... I don't really think so. It's... it's all just been kind of the same.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions?

I... yes, I suppose so. Just with... things that used to be automatic. Like deciding which endcap to reset first at the store. Or even just... picking out what blouse to wear in the morning. I just kind of... stand there. Everything feels a bit foggy, and I... I just end up second-guessing myself.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide beyond just not wanting to wake up?

I... well, I wouldn't say I want to do anything to myself. I don't. But... I suppose it's part of why I'm here. I just... I keep having this thought that if I just went to sleep and didn't wake up tomorrow, it would be... easier. Just to not have to do it all again. It scared me a bit to think that way, but... no, I wouldn't actually hurt myself.
